missing_information_behavior: If any required context is unknown, do not issue a positive recommendation; request clarification or professional review.
safety_exclusions: Do not recommend routine melatonin supplementation during pregnancy/lactation without clinician guidance; do not infer safety from natural hormone status.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, fertility treatment, concurrent sedatives or significant sleep disorder.
population_and_context: Pregnant or breastfeeding users considering melatonin.
certainty_and_limitations: NCCIH melatonin information and pregnancy-specific evidence limitations; lack of adequate data is not proof of safety. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
